title: Care for the watch you keep.
intro: Find an onboarded brand or dealer, explore its declared capabilities, and choose where to begin. Beirut Time connects you; the business assesses and performs the work.
saved: Choice saved. This is not a confirmed appointment or accepted service job.
unavailable: The directory cannot verify businesses right now. No unverified entries are shown.
empty: No eligible business in the loaded results. Load more if available, or try again.
signin: Sign in as a buyer to save your choice
authUnavailable: Your sign-in status is temporarily unavailable. No private change is confirmed.
authDenied: Sign-in access was denied. No private change is confirmed.
buyerRequired: Buyer access is required to save a choice.
select: Choose a business to see its scope and supported services.
notice: No work is approved here. Scopes are indicative; assessment, acceptance and a separate quote are required. Customization destinations are brands only.
error: The result is unresolved or the current revision was denied. Retry the same unchanged action first. Reload after a definite revision conflict.
stale: This profile changed. Reload before saving a choice.
businesses: Published profiles · current eligibility checked per page
maintenanceNotice: Only current permission for the selected business allows saving. Demonstration declarations are synthetic; a real offering requires recorded business confirmation.
profileSaved: Offering revision saved. No appointment or work has been authorized.
recover: The result is unresolved or the current revision was denied. Retry the same unchanged action first. Reload after a definite revision conflict.
updateRecovery: Current directory reads cannot be opened yet. Retry later. No selection, appointment or work is confirmed.
